description.en: Forces a character to keep rendering, bypassing the engine's normal visibility/draw-skip logic. Never called from any shipped script in script_clean/; behavior reconstructed from the native implementation, which accepts an optional mode string on top of the handle.
Optional force-draw mode (defaults to an internal "on" mode when omitted).

example.code:
// Force a character to keep rendering regardless of normal visibility rules
CMND_SET_DRAW_FORCE(hChara);
